title: Grade 4 Science — Weathering, Erosion, and Deposition
subject: Science
description: Practice with questions on water, wind, ice, sediment.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Rock cracks after water in a crack freezes. Which process broke the rock?
A river carries loose sand downstream. What process is this?
When a river slows and drops sediment, what happens?
Tree roots grow in cracks and split a rock. Which process is shown?
What can wind do to a pile of dry sand?
choices: make all grains the same size

questions.question: What can form where a river drops sediment near its mouth?
Why can thick grass reduce soil erosion?
choices: Roots help hold soil in place.

questions.question: Which is evidence that a stream carries sediment?
choices: A cloud casts a shadow nearby.
The water looks muddy after a storm.
Clear water freezes in a cup.

questions.question: Why do rounded river pebbles often become smoother?
choices: They gain new layers of leaves.
They rub against other rocks as they move.

questions.question: What usually moves loose particles before they settle as a dune?
What can glacial ice do as it moves?
How could a class compare erosion on bare and planted soil?
choices: Tilt the trays by different amounts.
Measure only how long the plants are.
Use different amounts of water and soil.
Pour equal water on equally tilted trays and compare runoff.

questions.question: Which action most directly slows runoff on a hillside?
Sediment dropped by a stream forms a sandbar. When might that happen?
Which process is happening when acid in rain slowly dissolves limestone?
Both moving ice and moving water can cause what change?
choices: carry rock pieces to new places

questions.question: Which step must happen before a stream can carry sediment from a solid rock face?
choices: The whole rock face must turn to steam.
Pieces must loosen or break off.

questions.question: How can repeated freeze and thaw widen a crack?
choices: Liquid water expands only when heated.

questions.question: Which is an example of deposition by the wind?
choices: A pile of sand grows behind a fence.
Wind lifts sand off a beach.
Air blows dust out of a room.
Strong wind strips soil from a bare field.

questions.question: After heavy rain, a rill appears on a bare slope. What made it?
choices: Roots added soil to the groove.
